paite: Huchih lai in kumpipa Darias in thupiak abawla, Babulon a goute koihkhawmna, laibute insung azong uhi.
heading: Kura Thupiak Muhkhiak Thakna

paite: Huchi in Akmetha ah, Media bial a om inpi ah laizial akimukhia a, huai ah chiamtehna ding in hichibang a gelh ahi.

"Kumpipa Kura akum khatna kum in, Kura kumpipa'n thupiak abawl hi: Jerusalem a Pathian inn tungtang, a-inn lam hi henla, kithoihnate a latna mun uh leh huai a suangphumte kiptak a koih hi hen; asanlam tong sawmguk, azatlam tong sawmguk;
Suang thupi taktak vual thum leh sing thak vual khat toh, huan sum sennate kumpipa' inn a kipan piakkhiak hi hen:

Nebukadnezzar in Jerusalem tempul a kipan a alakkhiak, Babulon lam a alak, Pathian inn a dangka-eng leh dangka tui-um belsuan piak nawn vek hi henla, Jerusalem a om Pathian insung ah amau mun chiat ah koih nawn vek hi hen."
"Tattenai, luipi khen a ukpipa, Shethar-boznai leh na kithuahpihte uh Apharsa mite, luipi khen a omte: huai inn lamna a kipan gamla ah om un:
heading: Kumpi Darias Laithon

paite: Hiai Pathian inn nasepna subuai kei un; Judate ukpipa leh Juda upate'n amun ah hiai Pathian inn lam uhen.

Huai lou in hiai Pathian inn lamna ding a hiai Juda upate kiang ah na hih ding uh thu ka bawl hi: kumpipa vante a kipan, luipi khen a siah a kipan mahmah in, hiai mite kiang a sumzatnate thanopna chiteng toh apiak ding ahi, huchi a dala a-omlouhna ding un.

Huan ataksapnate uh, bawngtalnoute, belamtalte, belamnoute, van Pathian kiang a halmang thillat ding huit buh, chi, uain leh thaute, Jerusalem a om siampute thu bang zel in, tatlak lou in niteng in amau piak ding ahi:
Huchi a van Pathian kiang a gimlim kithoihnate alat theih ua, kumpipa hinna leh atapate hinna a dia athumtheihna ding un.
Thupiak ka bawl lai a, kuapeuh in hiai thu a suklamdan leh a-inn a kipan inkam dohkhiak hi henla, huai ah amah dopkang touh leh henden in om hen; hiai ziak in a-inn ekvum a bawl hi hen.

Huai mah hihlamdang ding, Jerusalem a om hiai Pathian inn hihse ding a akhut uh kuansak ding kumpipate tengteng leh mite tengteng Pathian huai lai a teng ding a amin omsakpa'n paithal vek hen. Kei, Darias in, thupiak ka bawlta; thanopna tengteng toh sepkhiak in om hen," chi in.
Huchi in Tattenai, luipi khen a ukpipa, Shethar-boznai leh akithuahpihte un, kumpipa Darias in asawl ziak in, thanopna tengteng toh huchibang in asemkheta uhi.
heading: Tempul Latna

paite: Juda upate'n zawlnei Haggai leh Iddo tapa Zekariah genkholhna pansan in inn alam ua ma asawn zel uhi. Israel' Pathian thupiak dungzui leh Kura, Darias leh Persia kumpipa Artaksarses thupiak dungzui in inn alam ua azouta uhi.
Kumpipa Darias vaihawm akum gukna kum a om, Adar kha ani thum ni in hiai inn zoh ahita hi.
Huchi in Israel suante, siampute leh Levi mite leh saltanna ta dangte'n, hiai Pathian inn latna nuamtak in aneita uhi.
Hiai Pathian inn latna ah bawngtal zakhat, belamtal zanih, belamnou zali alan ua; Israel tengteng a dia khelhna thillat ding in, keltal sawm-le-nih, Israel namte zah dungzui in.
Huchi in Jerusalem a om, Pathian nasepna a ding in, Mosi laibu a kigelh bang in, siampute atan hawmna uah, Levi mite amun tan uah akoih uhi.
Huan saltanna tate'n akha khatna ani sawm-le-li ni in Paikan Ankuang alui uhi.
heading: Paikan Ankuang

paite: Siampute leh Levi mite lah akisiangsakkhawm vek ngal ua; avek un asiang uhi: huchi in saltanna tate a ding leh a-unaute uh siampute a ding leh amau mah a ding in, Paikan belamnou agou uhi.
Saltanna a kipan a hong paikhe nawn, Israel suante leh TOUPA, Israel' Pathian zong ding a, gam a khovel mite buahna a kipan amau leh amau kihuikhetuam tengteng in, ane uhi.

Nuamtak in ni sagih sung Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluina abawl uhi: TOUPA'N amaute nuam asasak in, Israel' Pathian, Pathian inn a nasepna khutte uh hatsak ding in amau lam ah Assuria kumpipa lungtang akiheisak hi.
